data.title: Week 2 quiz · From TradFi to DeFi

questions.questionText: Which feature commonly distinguishes DeFi from traditional financial services?

options.text: Every transaction is approved by a bank branch
Financial rules can be executed by blockchain-based protocols
There are no fees or risks

questions.questionText: What does self-custody mean when using a crypto wallet?

options.text: A bank holds and controls your keys
The wallet removes all transaction risk
You control the keys that authorize transactions

questions.questionText: Before trying a DeFi protocol, what should a new participant review?

options.text: Fees, custody, and smart contract risks
Only the logo and social follower count
Whether the protocol has a physical branch
